label: Refugees
plain: People outside their own country who need international protection because of conflict or persecution, counted under UNHCR's mandate at the end of the year (31 December).

label: Asylum seekers
plain: People who have asked for international protection and whose claim has not yet been decided, at the end of the year.

label: IDPs of concern to UNHCR
plain: People forced from their homes by conflict or violence who stay inside their own country and whom UNHCR protects or assists, at the end of the year. Conflict only: disaster IDPs are not included.

label: Other people in need of international protection
plain: People outside their country, usually forced across a border, who are not counted as refugees or asylum seekers but likely need international protection, at the end of the year.

label: Stateless people
plain: People not considered nationals by any country. Most have never been displaced. Some are also counted as refugees or asylum seekers.

label: Others of concern
plain: People UNHCR protects or assists who do not fit the other groups, at the end of the year.

label: Host community
plain: Local people living alongside displaced people whom UNHCR supports. Not displaced themselves.

label: Returned refugees
plain: Refugees who went back to their own country during the year. A yearly count, not a year-end total.

label: Returned IDPs
plain: IDPs supported by UNHCR who went back home during the year. A yearly count.

label: Resettlement arrivals
plain: Refugees who arrived during the year in a third country that agreed to admit them permanently.

label: Naturalisations
plain: Refugees who became citizens of their host country during the year.

label: Sex and age
plain: Year-end population split by sex and age group, where the host country reports it. Measure ids look like demographics:<population type>:<group>, e.g. demographics:REF:f_0_4 (female refugees aged 0 to 4). When a row gives only a total, the sex and age split is treated as missing, not as zero.

label: Asylum applications
plain: Claims for international protection lodged during the year. Measure ids look like asylum_applications:<authority>:<application type>:<stage of procedure>:<cases or persons>, with the codes exactly as UNHCR publishes them. Authority: G = government, U = UNHCR, J = joint. Other codes are listed in codes_to_confirm.
codes_to_confirm: Application type N, R, A, RA, NR, J; stage of procedure FI, AR, RA, FA, JR, IN, EO, TA. Their meanings are not given in the API documentation.

label: Asylum decisions
plain: Decisions on asylum claims during the year: recognised, given complementary protection, rejected, otherwise closed, and total. Measure ids look like asylum_decisions_<outcome>:<authority>:<stage>:<cases or persons>.

label: IDPs (conflict and violence), IDMC
plain: People living in internal displacement because of conflict or violence at the end of the year, as estimated by IDMC. Never add this to UNHCR's IDP figure: they overlap and are counted differently.
note: Most IDMC figures are estimates. IDMC publishes rounded headline figures; the original row shows both the exact and the rounded value.

label: New internal displacements (conflict and violence), IDMC
plain: Number of times people were newly forced to move inside their country because of conflict or violence during the year. Counts movements, not people: one person can be displaced more than once.

label: IDPs (disasters), IDMC, by event
plain: People still displaced by a disaster event at the end of the year, where IDMC reports it (mostly from 2019 onwards). Measure ids look like idps_idmc_disaster:<hazard type>.

label: New internal displacements (disasters), IDMC, by event
plain: Number of times people were forced to move by a disaster event (flood, storm, earthquake...) during the year. One row per event. Measure ids look like idmc_disaster_new:<hazard type>. Counts movements, not people.

label: Armed conflict intensity (UCDP/PRIO)
plain: 1 = minor armed conflict (25 to 999 battle-related deaths in the year); 2 = war (1,000 or more). One row per conflict, location and year; the location is in origin_iso3.

label: Armed conflict type (UCDP/PRIO)
plain: 1 = extrasystemic (colonial), 2 = interstate, 3 = intrastate (civil), 4 = internationalised intrastate.

label: Deaths in organized violence (UCDP, best estimate)
plain: People killed in the country during the year in state-based conflict, non-state conflict and one-sided violence against civilians combined (UCDP best estimate).

label: Deaths in organized violence (UCDP, low estimate)
plain: Low estimate of the same total.

label: Deaths in organized violence (UCDP, high estimate)
plain: High estimate of the same total.

label: Deaths in state-based conflict (UCDP, best)
plain: Deaths in fighting where at least one side is a government.

label: Deaths in non-state conflict (UCDP, best)
plain: Deaths in fighting between organised groups, none of them a government.

label: Deaths in one-sided violence (UCDP, best)
plain: Civilians deliberately killed by a government or an organised group.

label: Total population (World Bank)
plain: Everyone living in the country, mid-year estimate. Used only to give 'per 1,000 people' figures.

label: Refugees in government camps (Govt. of India)
plain: Sri Lankan refugees living in the 107 government camps in Tamil Nadu on the stated date, as reported by the Government of India.

label: Registered refugees outside camps (Govt. of India)
plain: Sri Lankan refugees living outside the camps who have registered at a police station, on the stated date.

label: Refugees, camps and outside (Govt. of India)
plain: Camp and registered non-camp refugees together, as given by the Government of India. Not comparable one-to-one with UNHCR's count: see the definitions crosswalk.

label: Refugees in the demographic data
plain: All refugees in this group in UNHCR's demographic data for the year (the row's Total).

label: Refugee women
plain: Refugees recorded as female, all ages (the row's 'Female total').

label: Refugee men
plain: Refugees recorded as male, all ages (the row's 'Male total').

label: Refugees with sex not recorded
plain: Worked out from the row: Total minus 'Female total' and 'Male total'. UNHCR gives no sex for these people.

label: Refugees aged 0–4
plain: Worked out from the row: 'Female 0 - 4' plus 'Male 0 - 4'.

label: Refugees aged 5–11
plain: Worked out from the row: 'Female 5 - 11' plus 'Male 5 - 11'.

label: Refugees aged 12–17
plain: Worked out from the row: 'Female 12 - 17' plus 'Male 12 - 17'.

label: Refugees aged 18–59
plain: Worked out from the row: 'Female 18 - 59' plus 'Male 18 - 59'.

label: Refugees aged 60 and over
plain: Worked out from the row: 'Female 60' plus 'Male 60'.

label: Refugees with age unknown
plain: Worked out from the row: 'Female other' plus 'Male other' (age unknown), plus everyone whose sex isn't recorded (UNHCR gives age groups only within each sex).
